notes.title: Soundtrack now available as free DLC
notes.content:
If you bought the game and loved listening to our synth-infused tunes, you can now download the entire soundtrack for free.


Includes the following music from Spectrum Break.

Synthetic Ocean (main menu)
Slow Roller (levels 1-8)
Boardwalk (levels 9-15)
Cybernetic Grooves (levels 16-35)
Opus Pocus (levels 36-50)
Lost (levels 51-54)
Lonely (level 55)
HWY (credits)
Drive (unused)

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Level 55 completely changed.

Made steam cloud achievement sync more consistent.

Reduced initial load time.

Increased button/slider size in the settings menu.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Level Edits to levels 46, 49, 52, 54, and 55.

The pause menu now shows how many blocks remain (beside the pie chart which shows the percentage).

Increased block line width.

Fixed level 21 HUD timer location.

Increased secret particle size.

Manual jump direction moved slightly upwards.

Fixed windows 7 menu bug with constant input.

Reduced the brightness of a block on level 15.

Improved data correction for incorrect save files with less than 55 best times.

notes.title: Spectrum Break releases on steam at 1pm EST tomorrow!
notes.content:
When I was 5 years old I used to draw sonic levels for fun, and I drew little mazes for classmates on sticky notes.

I have now done something 5-year-old me would think is amazing. I'm releasing a game. A full game I'm proud of. I'm so excited guys.

When development on Spectrum Break began, I was working on a platformer with mostly static levels, and a few zero gravity physics blocks. Then I got bored and applied a physics script to everything, then laughed because destroying the level was a lot more fun than what he was making. So that became the game.

Spectrum Break releases to Steam at 1pm EST tomorrow!
